title: Do the clocks kill?
excerpt: Every spring and autumn someone warns that the clock change brings more crashes. Across 9.1 million collisions in Great Britain since 1979, the week after the change looks like any other week.
seo_description: Road collisions in the week after the clocks change, Great Britain 1979 to 2025: +0.8% in spring, -0.1% in autumn.
header_alt: Title card on cream paper reading 'Do the clocks kill?' with the week-after changes for spring and autumn and a line chart of daily collisions around the change that stays flat.
